site.sitedescription:
Maar occupied by a marshy lake. Physiography: trachyte and rhyolite domes.
Depending on the seasonal and interannual climatic fluctuations, its varies from a small lake with circumneutral water to an acidic bog with Cyperaceae hummocks and water holes. Water level fluctuations ranged over 1.8 m during 1995–1997.
